level.title: Levels entered
level.rank_note: act, then Levels.txt order (the order a player walks into them)

monster.title: Monster classes created
monster.rank_note: earliest level whose Levels.txt mon/nmon/umon columns name the class (minions and spawns inherit their parent's)

monster-ai.title: Monster AI (monstats AI column of the classes whose AI function ran)
monster-ai.rank_note: earliest spawn rank of a monster with that AI

skill.title: Skills started or done (srvst / srvdo)
skill.rank_note: player skills: the first level of the act a character of the skill's reqlevel plays (act I from 1, II 15, III 24, IV 30, V 35) plus the levels above that band; monster skills: the earliest spawn rank of a monster with the skill (Skill1-8)

missile.title: Missiles created
missile.rank_note: rank of the earliest skill (srvmissile, a-c) or monster mode missile that creates it

state.title: States applied
state.rank_note: rank of the earliest skill whose aurastate / auratargetstate / passivestate it is

object.title: Objects operated (objects row, operate function)
object.rank_note: operate function commonness (chests, doors, shrines, wells, waypoints, portals first), then row

item.title: Items created (base item, quality)
item.rank_note: base item level (level column: potions, scrolls, keys and gems are level 0); quest items after (+1000); non-spawnable rows not listed

npc-topic.title: NPC interactions (interact, menu action, quest message)
npc-topic.rank_note: npc=1 interact=1 monstats rows in monstats order (act I NPCs first: the rows follow the acts)
